thread:
elaine: quick PSA — PR 1024 landed but I noticed the tracing-hooks migration doc still points to the old /v1/traces/setup link (404). Can someone patch before the next release?

ravi: thanks for catching this! where did you see it? i can open a tiny PR to fix the link + update the code snippet.

elaine: top of the migration guide under 'Install the hook' section. also the python snippet uses the old Client.init signature which breaks with the sdk v2 packages. snippet below: `from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")` — that init no longer exists.

sofia: oof. i remembered we changed that in sdk 2.1 — new usage is `from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))` (also shows env example). i can push a docs PR to both fix link + update snippet.

mike: tiny request: can you also add a short callout about the cost/latency breakdown being in Console > Observability > Token-costs? a lot of customers file support tickets asking where to find the breakdown after migrating. maybe a 1-line pointer is enough.

sofia: makes sense. i'll add a one-liner and a screenshot placeholder. do we have a public permalink for that dashboard?

ravi: use /console/observability/costs?utm=docs (internal friendly). if you want a direct link for the docs, use the canonical route: https://app.redwood.ai/console/observability/costs (will redirect in-prod).

elaine: one more: the tracing hook example in the guide demonstrates span attributes that we no longer emit (service.version). we should either remove that attribute or mark as prior-release example. otherwise folks will be confused when their traces don't show the field.

sofia: good catch. i'll change the snippet to demonstrate `span.set_attribute("deployment", "blue")` and add a small note: "if you upgraded from <2024-10, you may see older attribute names".

mike: can we also include a tiny shim example for people on legacy SDKs? like a short `if hasattr(...)` check? saves a support ping.

ravi: thumbs up to shim. something like: ```python
from redwood_sdk import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
# legacy fallback for older SDKs
if not hasattr(client, "track_span"):
    # emulate minimal API surface used by examples
    def track_span(name, **attrs):
        return client.create_span(name, attributes=attrs)
    client.track_span = track_span
```

elaine: perfect. last thing — doc-bot reported an orphaned image link in the same doc: `![screenshot](https://storage.redwood.ai/missing/trace-costs.png)` which 404s in prod builds. can we either replace with the new screenshot or remove?

sofia: i'll replace with the updated screenshot from the PR branch and include alt text.

doc-bot: automated check: PR 1027 created by sofia includes: link fix, snippet update, shim example, screenshot update. Docs CI preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1027 — rendering shows no broken links in staging.

mike: leaving a quick review. can you add a short changelog bullet under the migration page "what changed"? one line saying "SDK v2: client init and attribute names updated — see migration snippet".

sofia: added the changelog bullet and updated date. pushing commit.

ravi: LGTM. tagging @docs-rollback for visibility in case we need a hotfix.

elaine: thanks everyone — planning to include in the 2024-11 console release notes. i'll follow up if QA finds anything else. :thumbsup:

mike: awesome, thanks. :rocket:

doc-bot: CI deploy merged. PR 1027 merged to main by sofia at 1715000180.
